data.description:
## What happens

The MCP `edit_ticket` tool has no `parent` parameter. Reparenting a ticket is possible
on the CLI but not through the MCP server, so a session following the "drive the
tracker through the MCP server" rule in `AGENTS.md` cannot do it without shelling out.

## Why it matters

`AGENTS.md` makes MCP the route for tracker writes and carves out only local-code
operations. Reparenting is a tracker write, so the carve-out does not cover it, and
the rule and the tool surface disagree.

Reparenting is routine under the standing authorization to split tickets: a slice filed
before its epic exists, or filed under the wrong parent during decomposition, needs
moving. Epic 87d8's 11 slices were all filed with the right parent only because the
epic already existed.

## Change

Add an optional `parent` parameter to the MCP `edit_ticket` tool, forwarding to the
same library path the CLI uses, so the two surfaces agree.

Reparenting has real constraints — a cycle must be refused, and the parent must exist.
Those live in the library already; the tool must surface their errors rather than
reimplement or swallow them.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1** `edit_ticket` accepts an optional `parent` and, when supplied, the
      ticket's `parent_id` afterward equals the resolved id of that parent.
- [ ] **AC2** The parameter accepts the same identifier forms the rest of the MCP
      surface accepts — alias, two-quad short id, and full canonical id.
- [ ] **AC3** A parent that does not resolve is refused with an error naming the
      unresolvable value; the ticket's `parent_id` is unchanged.
- [ ] **AC4** A parent that would create a cycle is refused and the ticket is unchanged.
- [ ] **AC5** Omitting `parent` leaves `parent_id` untouched, including on a ticket
      that currently has none.
- [ ] **AC6** The tool's `outputSchema` and `docs/mcp-reference.md` both describe the
      new parameter.
- [ ] **AC7** `make verify` exits 0.

## Out of scope

Adding `parent` to `create_ticket`, which already has it.
data.title: MCP edit_ticket cannot reparent a ticket
